description.narrative:
The Project aim to engage young adults in Bauchi Diocese with life shaping issues, and to assist them to make conscious choices on how they will live their lives in Peace and make a positive impact within their community.
The late Bishop John Moore of Bauchi Diocese, through the Catholic Youth Organisation of Nigeria (CYON) and the youth chaplains realising the Poor relationship between Christians and Muslims the diocese and the Poor understanding of Sexual health related issues, developed a strategic plan to respond to these issues by building the Youth Formation Centre to help re-orientate youths in the area, which is highly exposed to conflict.
The level of violence in Bauchi and neighbouring state has caused lost of lives and property and has instil fear and suspicion among the Muslim and Christian Communities in these areas. Children have been abused and live pain and fear. Sexual Health is almost a taboo in the areas and rarely being discussed in the target area.
YFC work to address the challenges faced by youth in the area, given the area, helping youth understand the different religious and how all religion preach peace and love for one another just as God want it to be. It is hope that there would be attitude change between Christians and Muslims Youth in relations with one another, and that Christian and Muslim Youths would work together in interfaith works. And more Youth will participate and take Leadership roles and responsibilities in the communities where we work.
Strategies to address this include;
1. Strengthen YFC relationship with the Bauchi Youth network, which is predominantly a Muslim Youth group 2. Network with the Alternative to Violence Programme and the Interfaith Youth Council for Muslims and Christians 3. Relating with the Bauchi State Ministry of Youth for creating awareness on Sexual Health matters 4. Ongoing capacity building for youth leaders in our target area
